title: Riley C02 shutdown quiescence completion marker v2
description: A create-only, nonhidden `<artifact_filename>.complete` marker written only after the shutdown-v2 artifact has been fsynced. The marker binds the exact artifact bytes. A shutdown JSON leaf without this matching marker is incomplete evidence.

artifact_filename.description: A nonhidden direct-child JSON leaf. The 246-byte maximum leaves room for the required `.complete` marker within a 255-byte POSIX filename.
